lines: •Narrowing full year 2026 Adjusted (non-GAAP) operating earnings guidance range to $2.85-$2.91 per share and affirming operating EPS compounded annual growth near top end of 5-7% from 2025 to 2029

With our performance for the year, we are narrowing our full-year 2026 guidance range to $2.85 to $2.91 per share, and affirming annualized earnings growth near the top end of 5% to 7% from 2025 through 2029.
